Samhorodok Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Vinnytsia Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Samhorodok's Jewish community, first settled in the late 18th or early 19th century, reached about a third of the town's population by 1897. On June 4, 1942, following the establishment of a ghetto that May, 492 Jews — including 245 children — were executed near the village of Gremnovka; a few able-bodied workers were spared and sent to Kozyatyn, documented elsewhere in this collection. A monument erected in 2018 now marks the mass grave on the cemetery grounds.
